# 审稿报告 — gen-depth-contamination (Round 20)

**论文**: Generational Depth Estimation of Recursive Synthetic Text: Measuring the Discrimination Boundary
**目标 Venue**: EMNLP 2026 (ARR May 2026)
**审稿模式**: Fresh（重新审稿）
**Reviewer 编排**: 2 人（R1: 方法严谨性, R2: 新颖性/完整性）
**轮次**: 1 轮收敛（关键问题共识，无需 Round 2）

---

## Summary

本文形式化定义了"generational depth estimation"这一新任务，提出 K*（discrimination boundary）为分类器能可靠区分相邻递归生成深度的最大值（Eq. 1, θ=0.60）。使用 15 维手工统计特征 + OBD-LightGBM，在 10 个模型配置（6 架构家族, 1B-32B）、4 个文本域（C4, Wikipedia, arXiv, Code）、4 种解码策略上系统测量。核心发现：C4 web text K*=2（7/9 continuation-mode 配置, 4/6 families），θ-invariant 域排序 arXiv(3) > C4=Code(2) > Wikipedia(1)，DeBERTa 建立 two-tier ceiling（低复杂度域无提升，高复杂度域 +1），retrain-chain K*=7 vs prompt-chain K*=2。

---

## Strengths

**S1. 问题形式化新颖且填补了真实空白。** [R1+R2 共识] K* 将 "递归生成文本在某深度后不可区分" 这一模糊直觉转化为可操作的量化指标，填补了 binary detection（无深度估计）和 population-level model collapse theory（无 per-text 工具）之间的空白。

**S2. 实验覆盖面和统计严谨性达到高水准。** [R1+R2 共识] 10 模型 × 4 域 × 4 解码策略的系统测量，每个 K* claim 由 bootstrap 95% CI + permutation test 支撑。Cross-scorer ANOVA、LOFO cross-validation、changepoint analysis (PELT)、DeBERTa upper bound、retrain-chain 对比提供多角度交叉验证。附录约 50 张 table/figure 的消融分析远超同类工作。

**S3. θ-invariant domain ordering 是论文最强、最鲁棒的发现。** [R1+R2 共识] arXiv > C4 = Code > Wikipedia 的排序在 θ∈[0.55, 0.70] 全范围、跨架构、跨规模、跨 scorer 保持不变。Mistral-7B 在 C4 上 K*=1 但 arXiv 上 K*=3，提供了域结构（而非模型身份）驱动 discriminability 的强证据。这是一个不依赖 θ 选择的发现。

**S4. Confound 控制系统到位。** [R1] Wikipedia scorer confound 通过 cross-family scoring 解决；self-BLEU fold 内计算 + 14D ablation (Δ≤0.003)；length confound 分析（depths 1-5 within-model ≤6 tokens）。

**S5. DeBERTa two-tier ceiling 和 retrain-chain 对比有价值。** [R1+R2] 从两侧界定 K* 范围：15D statistical features 给出 lower bound，DeBERTa 给出 feature-dependent upper bound（C4/Code 匹配, Wikipedia/arXiv +1/+2）；prompt-chain K*=2 vs retrain-chain K*=7 区分了文本内在信息损失与训练动态效应。

**S6. Limitations section 极为坦诚。** [R1] 9 个方面的 explicit limitation，包括 Qwen family balance、marginal CI margins、filtering effect size diminishing at lower contamination ratios。

---

## Weaknesses

### Must-Fix (3)

**[MF-1] DPI→adjacent-pair distinguishability 论证缺口** [R1 N1, critical]
Section 3.1: DPI 保证 I(X;Y₁) ≥ I(X;Y₂) ≥ ... ≥ 0（累积信息关于原始 X 的衰减），但 K* 衡量的是相邻对 (Y_{k-1}, Y_k) 的 pairwise AUC。这两个量之间缺乏形式化桥梁。Introduction line 28 "DPI implies...motivating a finite discrimination boundary K*" 暗示了比实际更强的理论保证。有限 K* 的真正来源是 Markov chain ergodic convergence（相邻转移趋同），非 DPI 本身。
→ 建议：将 DPI 限定为 motivational，补充 Markov mixing 论证或直接定位为 empirical finding。

**[MF-2] θ=0.60 后验选择的循环性 / K*=2 的 threshold 依赖性** [R1 N2 + R2 W2, critical, 两位 Reviewer 共识]
θ 选在 1v2 AUC cluster (0.611-0.695) 和 2v3 cluster (0.549-0.589) 的经验间隔处。K*=2 的 stability window 仅 5pp [0.575, 0.625]：θ=0.55 时部分配置达 K*=3，θ=0.70 时全部降为 K*=1。LOFO θ̂∈[0.5725, 0.6004] 上界恰好 = 0.60（边缘非中心），1/9 不一致。论文标题和 abstract 以 K*=2 为卖点，但这个数字的 robustness 远不如 θ-invariant domain ordering。changepoint analysis (PELT, 35/37 agree within ±1) 是最强的 θ-free 验证但仅附录一句话提及。

(a) Mohamed et al. (ACL 2025 main), "LLM as a Broken Telephone: Iterative Generation Distorts Information" (arXiv:2502.20258, ACL Anthology 2025.acl-long.371)：研究 LLM 迭代生成中信息失真的累积，已发表于 ACL 主会议。

15D statistics vs 184M fine-tuned encoder 的 capacity 差异巨大。DeBERTa 在 Wikipedia 将 K* 从 1 提到 3，说明 K*=1 并非 domain 固有 ceiling。建议改为 "feature-set-dependent gap"，承认更强表示可能进一步提升 K*。

Abstract contribution (c) 强调 "80-92% accuracy retention" 但未提及 7B boundary-level 4/6 pairs 落在 θ 以下的脆弱性。建议在 Abstract 和正文中平衡报告。

15D 特征 + OBD-LightGBM 均为标准工具。论文 novelty 主要在问题定义和实证发现。建议在 Introduction 加 2-3 句 explicit rationale：简单方法建立 lower bound，任何更复杂方法只能提升（DeBERTa 已证明）。

未综合 Discussion 中的 broader implications（data curation 指导、model collapse 连接、framework 可扩展性、future directions）。建议扩展到 12-15 行。

**[SF-8] Prompt-chain vs retrain-chain 混合场景讨论不足** [R2 W7]
真实 web-scale 污染是 prompt-chain 和 retrain-chain 的混合体。建议 Discussion 增加 2-3 句讨论混合场景预期或声明为 open question。

**[SF-9] Scale 外推 "200-500B crossover" 仅基于 3 个点** [R1 W4]
1.5B/14B/32B 三点 log-linear 拟合，AUC 总降幅仅 0.8pp。建议改为定性表述（"scale trend suggests eventual decay"）。

C4 subsampled to n=2,200 yields K*=1，cross-scorer 下仅 2/4 generators 通过 strict CI criterion。建议主文 arXiv K*=3 讨论时加入样本量限定。

**S1. 问题形式化新颖且填补了真实空白。** [R1+R2 共识] K* 将 "递归生成文本在某深度后不可区分" 这一模糊直觉转化为可操作的量化指标，填补了 binary detection（无深度估计）和 population-level model collapse theory（无 per-text 工具）之间的空白。

**S2. 实验覆盖面和统计严谨性达到高水准。** [R1+R2 共识] 10 模型 × 4 域 × 4 解码策略的系统测量，每个 K* claim 由 bootstrap 95% CI + permutation test 支撑。Cross-scorer ANOVA、LOFO cross-validation、changepoint analysis (PELT)、DeBERTa upper bound、retrain-chain 对比提供多角度交叉验证。附录约 50 张 table/figure 的消融分析远超同类工作。

**S3. θ-invariant domain ordering 是论文最强、最鲁棒的发现。** [R1+R2 共识] arXiv > C4 = Code > Wikipedia 的排序在 θ∈[0.55, 0.70] 全范围、跨架构、跨规模、跨 scorer 保持不变。Mistral-7B 在 C4 上 K*=1 但 arXiv 上 K*=3，提供了域结构（而非模型身份）驱动 discriminability 的强证据。这是一个不依赖 θ 选择的发现。

**S4. Confound 控制系统到位。** [R1] Wikipedia scorer confound 通过 cross-family scoring 解决；self-BLEU fold 内计算 + 14D ablation (Δ≤0.003)；length confound 分析（depths 1-5 within-model ≤6 tokens）。

**S5. DeBERTa two-tier ceiling 和 retrain-chain 对比有价值。** [R1+R2] 从两侧界定 K* 范围：15D statistical features 给出 lower bound，DeBERTa 给出 feature-dependent upper bound（C4/Code 匹配, Wikipedia/arXiv +1/+2）；prompt-chain K*=2 vs retrain-chain K*=7 区分了文本内在信息损失与训练动态效应。

**S6. Limitations section 极为坦诚。** [R1] 9 个方面的 explicit limitation，包括 Qwen family balance、marginal CI margins、filtering effect size diminishing at lower contamination ratios。

---

## Weaknesses

### Must-Fix (3)

**[MF-1] DPI→adjacent-pair distinguishability 论证缺口** [R1 N1, critical]
Section 3.1: DPI 保证 I(X;Y₁) ≥ I(X;Y₂) ≥ ... ≥ 0（累积信息关于原始 X 的衰减），但 K* 衡量的是相邻对 (Y_{k-1}, Y_k) 的 pairwise AUC。这两个量之间缺乏形式化桥梁。Introduction line 28 "DPI implies...motivating a finite discrimination boundary K*" 暗示了比实际更强的理论保证。有限 K* 的真正来源是 Markov chain ergodic convergence（相邻转移趋同），非 DPI 本身。
→ 建议：将 DPI 限定为 motivational，补充 Markov mixing 论证或直接定位为 empirical finding。

**[MF-2] θ=0.60 后验选择的循环性 / K*=2 的 threshold 依赖性** [R1 N2 + R2 W2, critical, 两位 Reviewer 共识]

→ 建议：Section 2 新增 "Iterative generation dynamics" 段落讨论两篇工作，明确增量在于 per-text, per-depth operational tool。

C4 subsampled to n=2,200 yields K*=1，cross-scorer 下仅 2/4 generators 通过 strict CI criterion。建议主文 arXiv K*=3 讨论时加入样本量限定。

4	Web-scale text corpora are increasingly contaminated by synthetic content that has itself been generated from earlier synthetic content.
5	Estimates suggest that a substantial fraction of online text is machine-generated~\cite{sun2025aigt, spennemann2025quantifying}, and this share continues to rise.

7	This degradation arises in both \emph{retrain-chains} (iteratively training on model outputs) and \emph{prompt-chains} (recursively prompting a fixed model to generate from its own prior outputs); we study prompt-chains, which isolate text-intrinsic information loss from training dynamics (Appendix~\ref{sec:extended_limitations}).
8	Yet the dominant paradigm treats all machine-generated text identically and ignores the generational depth dimension.
9	
10	\begin{figure*}[t]
11	\centering
12	\includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{figures/pipeline.pdf}
13	\caption{Generational depth estimation pipeline. Seed documents are recursively passed through a generation operator $G_\delta$ to produce a depth chain. Statistical features are fed to the OBD-LightGBM classifier for depth prediction.}
14	\label{fig:pipeline}
15	\end{figure*}
16	
17	This gap cuts across multiple communities.
18	Binary detectors~\cite{basani2026diveye, zhang2024minkpp} produce no depth estimate (Section~\ref{sec:binary_confidence}).
19	Membership inference~\cite{zawalski2026codec} addresses a different question, and the model collapse literature~\cite{shumailov2024collapse, alemohammad2024selfconsuming, schaeffer2025position} provides no per-text tool.
20	Data selection methods~\cite{xie2023dsir, tirumala2023d4, drayson2025} likewise ignore recursive depth.
21	No existing method estimates how many rounds of recursive generation a text has undergone.
22	
23	Knowing whether the discriminable depth is finite, and where it saturates, has direct practical consequences.
24	For data curation, the saturation point determines filtering granularity: if discrimination collapses at depth 2, graduated weighting beyond that boundary injects noise, and binary filtering becomes the principled choice.
25	Model collapse theory predicts monotonic quality degradation across generations, but existing analyses are population-level and provide no per-text measure of where degradation saturates.
26	$\Kempirical$ fills this gap by localizing the generation at which adjacent outputs become empirically indistinguishable.
27	
28	The Data Processing Inequality implies that information degrades monotonically across generations, motivating a finite discrimination boundary $\Kstar$; its actual value is determined empirically.
29	We present an empirical characterization study that formalizes $\Kempirical$ (the maximum depth at which a classifier reliably distinguishes adjacent generations) and measures it under prompt-chain generation using 15 statistical features computed via a fixed reference scorer (Section~\ref{sec:features}) and an Ordinal Binary Decomposition (OBD) LightGBM classifier.
30	We operationalize $\Kempirical$ as the deepest $k \geq 1$ where the pairwise $\auc_{k-1,k}$ exceeds $\theta = 0.60$ (Section~\ref{sec:formulation}).
31	
32	Our contributions:
33	\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*),nosep]
34	  \item \textbf{First empirical measurement of $\Kempirical$} across 10 model configurations (6 architecture families, 1B--14B), 4 source domains (3 text + 1 code), and 4 decoding strategies at $\theta{=}0.60$: 4/6 families (7/9 continuation-mode configurations) yield $\Kempirical{=}2$ on C4 ($p \leq 0.002$; Section~\ref{sec:kstar_boundary}); multi-source pooling preserves domain-calibrated $\Kempirical$ across all four domains ($+0.008$ $\auc$ for generator identity).

\section{Introduction}
\label{sec:introduction}

Web-scale text corpora are increasingly contaminated by synthetic content that has itself been generated from earlier synthetic content.
Estimates suggest that a substantial fraction of online text is machine-generated~\cite{sun2025aigt, spennemann2025quantifying}, and this share continues to rise.
When synthetic text is recursively fed back as input, the resulting multi-generational content degrades with each iteration: tail modes vanish, lexical diversity contracts, and surprisal distributions flatten~\cite{shumailov2024collapse, dohmatob2024model}.
This degradation arises in both \emph{retrain-chains} (iteratively training on model outputs) and \emph{prompt-chains} (recursively prompting a fixed model to generate from its own prior outputs); we study prompt-chains, which isolate text-intrinsic information loss from training dynamics (Appendix~\ref{sec:extended_limitations}).
Yet the dominant paradigm treats all machine-generated text identically and ignores the generational depth dimension.

\begin{figure*}[t]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{figures/pipeline.pdf}
\caption{Generational depth estimation pipeline. Seed documents are recursively passed through a generation operator $G_\delta$ to produce a depth chain. Statistical features are fed to the OBD-LightGBM classifier for depth prediction.}
\label{fig:pipeline}
\end{figure*}

This gap cuts across multiple communities.
Binary detectors~\cite{basani2026diveye, zhang2024minkpp} produce no depth estimate (Section~\ref{sec:binary_confidence}).
Membership inference~\cite{zawalski2026codec} addresses a different question, and the model collapse literature~\cite{shumailov2024collapse, alemohammad2024selfconsuming, schaeffer2025position} provides no per-text tool.
Data selection methods~\cite{xie2023dsir, tirumala2023d4, drayson2025} likewise ignore recursive depth.
No existing method estimates how many rounds of recursive generation a text has undergone.

Knowing whether the discriminable depth is finite, and where it saturates, has direct practical consequences.
For data curation, the saturation point determines filtering granularity: if discrimination collapses at depth 2, graduated weighting beyond that boundary injects noise, and binary filtering becomes the principled choice.
Model collapse theory predicts monotonic quality degradation across generations, but existing analyses are population-level and provide no per-text measure of where degradation saturates.
$\Kempirical$ fills this gap by localizing the generation at which adjacent outputs become empirically indistinguishable.

The Data Processing Inequality implies that information degrades monotonically across generations, motivating a finite discrimination boundary $\Kstar$; its actual value is determined empirically.
We present an empirical characterization study that formalizes $\Kempirical$ (the maximum depth at which a classifier reliably distinguishes adjacent generations) and measures it under prompt-chain generation using 15 statistical features computed via a fixed reference scorer (Section~\ref{sec:features}) and an Ordinal Binary Decomposition (OBD) LightGBM classifier.
We operationalize $\Kempirical$ as the deepest $k \geq 1$ where the pairwise $\auc_{k-1,k}$ exceeds $\theta = 0.60$ (Section~\ref{sec:formulation}).

Our contributions:
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*),nosep]
  \item \textbf{First empirical measurement of $\Kempirical$} across 10 model configurations (6 architecture families, 1B--14B), 4 source domains (3 text + 1 code), and 4 decoding strategies at $\theta{=}0.60$: 4/6 families (7/9 continuation-mode configurations) yield $\Kempirical{=}2$ on C4 ($p \leq 0.002$; Section~\ref{sec:kstar_boundary}); multi-source pooling preserves domain-calibrated $\Kempirical$ across all four domains ($+0.008$ $\auc$ for generator identity).
  Zero-shot frontier LLMs likewise collapse beyond $\Kempirical$: per-depth recall at depths $\geq 2$ ranges from 8--38\% (vs.\ 20\% chance), indicating error redistribution rather than genuine depth recovery (Section~\ref{sec:why_kstar}).
  \item \textbf{Domain ordering}: arXiv ($\Kempirical{=}3$) $>$ C4 ($\Kempirical{=}2$) $=$ Code ($\Kempirical{=}2$) $>$ Wikipedia ($\Kempirical{=}1$) holds across tested configurations; code (Python) matches web text depth despite a different modality, confirmed by multi-source pooling (Section~\ref{sec:cross_domain}).
  \item \textbf{Transfer and consistency check}: largely generator-independent features within continuation mode enable 80--92\% accuracy retention among tested configurations ($\rho > 0.90$; Section~\ref{sec:transfer}), though boundary-level $\Kempirical$ assignments are fragile under cross-model transfer (4/6 off-diagonal 7B pairs fall below $\theta$); as a consistency check, domain-appropriate $\Kempirical$ correctly predicts binary ${>}$ graduated filtering for web text (Section~\ref{sec:filtering}).
\end{enumerate}

22

\section{Method}
\label{sec:method}

\subsection{Problem Formulation}
\label{sec:formulation}

A generation operator $G_\delta$ (LLM + decoding strategy $\delta$) produces successive generations $X \to Y_1 \to \cdots \to Y_K$, where $Y_k = G_\delta(Y_{k-1})$ and $Y_0 \triangleq X$ (Figure~\ref{fig:pipeline}).
This sequence forms a Markov chain.
By the Data Processing Inequality, $I(X; Y_1) \geq I(X; Y_2) \geq \cdots \geq 0$: the original signal degrades monotonically.
Together with Markov chain convergence, this motivates a finite $\Ktheory$ beyond which adjacent generations become indistinguishable; DPI guarantees existence but does not bound $\Ktheory$, so the actual saturation depth must be measured empirically.

We define the operational lower bound $K^*_{\text{empirical}}$ (hereafter $\Kempirical$):
\begin{equation}
  \Kempirical = \max\!\bigl\{k \!\geq\! 1 : \mathrm{CI}_{\mathrm{low}}(\auc_{j\text{-}1,j}) > \theta,\ \forall j \!\leq\! k\bigr\},
  \label{eq:kstar}
\end{equation}
where $\mathrm{CI}_{\mathrm{low}}(\auc_{k-1,k})$ is the lower bound of a 95\% bootstrap confidence interval (1{,}000 resamples\footnote{Boundary-pair results in Table~\ref{tab:kstar_ci} use 1{,}000 resamples; arXiv cross-scorer CIs (Table~\ref{tab:arxiv_crossscorer_ci}) use 10{,}000 for tighter bounds at the margin.}) over the pairwise AUC (Area Under the ROC Curve) between depths $k{-}1$ and $k$, and $\theta = 0.60$ is a post-hoc operational threshold (motivated below).
This criterion ensures that $\Kempirical$ reflects statistically robust discriminability rather than sampling noise; the $\forall j \leq k$ constraint is naturally satisfied because $\auc_{k,k+1}$ decreases monotonically for all pairs above $\theta$ across all tested configurations; negligible fluctuations ($\Delta < 0.02$) occur only at deeper depths where discrimination approaches chance level (Table~\ref{tab:kstar_ci}).
Since 0v1 $\auc > \theta$ in all tested configurations, $\Kempirical \geq 1$; $\Kempirical{=}0$ (undetectable first-generation text) is not observed.
$\Kempirical$ is an operational quantity jointly conditioned on the feature set and threshold $\theta$; the domain ordering is stable across $\theta \in [0.575, 0.65]$ (Section~\ref{sec:kstar_boundary}), though absolute $\Kempirical$ values shift with $\theta$.
We additionally verify that non-boundary-pair CI upper bounds fall below $\theta$ (Section~\ref{sec:kstar_boundary}).

\paragraph{Threshold choice.}
We set $\theta{=}0.60$ as a post-hoc operational threshold, chosen at the empirical discontinuity in the AUC distribution (Figure~\ref{fig:kstar_theta}).
A 10{,}000-iteration permutation test yields a 95th-percentile null of ${<}\,0.55$ and $p < 0.002$ for all boundary comparisons, placing $\theta{=}0.60$ well above the empirical null.
$\Kempirical{=}2$ is stable across $\theta \in [0.55, 0.65]$ for all but two marginal configurations (Table~\ref{tab:kstar_ci_extended}): 1v2 AUC values cluster at $0.61$--$0.70$ while 2v3 values cluster at $0.55$--$0.59$, creating a ${\sim}$5--11\,pp discontinuity.
Only at extremes does $\Kempirical$ shift: $\theta{=}0.55$ yields $\Kempirical{=}3$ for two Qwen configurations; $\theta{=}0.70$ yields $\Kempirical{=}1$ across all configurations.
The downstream filtering evaluation (Section~\ref{sec:filtering}) uses the OBD classifier without re-optimizing $\theta$, avoiding circularity.
A leave-one-family-out (LOFO) cross-validation on C4 provides an internal consistency check (not external validation): each of five folds derives $\hat{\theta}$ from the gap midpoint between $\min(\auc_{1v2})$ and $\max(\auc_{2v3})$ over the remaining families, yielding $\hat{\theta} \in [0.5725, 0.6004]$; $\theta{=}0.60$ falls within this range, and 8/9 held-out predictions match the original $\Kempirical$ (the single mismatch is the borderline rewrite-mode configuration; Table~\ref{tab:theta_lofo}).
ArXiv corroborates with 6/6 LOFO agreement; Wikipedia is underdetermined because most models produce near-chance 1v2 AUC, invalidating the gap-based derivation (Appendix~\ref{sec:theta_lofo}).


\subsection{Features and Classifier}
\label{sec:features}

Each document is characterized by a 15-dimensional feature vector spanning four groups: \emph{surprisal moments} (mean, std, skewness, kurtosis; 4~dims), \emph{surprisal derivatives} (mean and std of first- and second-order differences, plus first-order skewness; 5~dims), \emph{vocabulary diversity} (type-token ratio, hapax legomena ratio, self-BLEU; 3~dims), and \emph{frequency tail statistics} (frequency kurtosis, entropy, rare token fraction; 3~dims).
All features are computed from token-level surprisal values via an external scorer model (full definitions in Table~\ref{tab:s5_features}, Appendix).
Self-BLEU is computed within each CV fold using only same-fold, same-depth reference samples to prevent leakage; it ranks \#1 in 1/8 conditions (greedy decoding) but is absent from the top-3 in all 7 others.
Removing self-BLEU reduces mean $\auc_{1v2}$ by $< 1$\,pp across all models (14D $\Kempirical = 2$ for all 4 configurations; bootstrap CIs in Table~\ref{tab:selfbleu_ablation}); in deployment where depth labels are unavailable, self-BLEU can be replaced with corpus-level self-similarity or omitted with minimal performance loss.
Hand-crafted features enable cross-generator transfer without retraining and permit attribution of discriminative power to specific text properties.

We use \emph{Ordinal Binary Decomposition} (OBD), decomposing the $(K{+}1)$-class problem into $K$ cumulative binary sub-classifiers, each estimating $P(\text{depth} > k \mid \mathbf{x})$ via LightGBM~\cite{ke2017lightgbm} (hyperparameters in Table~\ref{tab:s6_lgbm_params}).
OBD achieves lower MAE than multiclass LightGBM (e.g., 0.984 vs.\ 1.016 on Qwen-rewrite) while maintaining superior pairwise $\auc$ (mean 0.6095 vs.\ 0.4883 for ordinal logistic regression).

\subsection{Experimental Setup}
\label{sec:experimental_setup}

We evaluate ten configurations spanning six architecture families (Table~\ref{tab:setup}): Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (rewrite and continuation modes), Qwen2.5-1.5B (base, continuation), Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B, Pythia-1.4B, OLMo-1B, Gemma-2-2B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, and Mistral-7B (all continuation except Qwen-rw).
Each uses 5{,}000 C4~\cite{raffel2020t5} seeds truncated to 256 tokens, recursively generated for $K{=}5$ iterations (30{,}000 documents per configuration).
Default decoding: nucleus $p{=}0.95$, $T{=}1.0$; decoding ablation covers greedy, $T{=}0.7$, and $T{=}1.2$.
Continuation mode truncates seeds to 128 tokens and extends to 256; rewrite mode paraphrases the full text.
Evaluation: 5-fold GroupKFold cross-validation grouped by seed document; pairwise $\auc$ as primary metric.

1	# Paper Framing — gen-depth-contamination
2	
3	## Target Venue
4	- Primary: EMNLP 2026 Main (ARR submission May 25, 2026)
5	- Fallback: EMNLP 2026 Findings
6	- Backup: AAAI 2027 (abstract July 25, paper August 1)
7	
8	## Canonical Experimental Condition
9	
10	**Continuation mode 是 cross-model 结论的基础。**
11	
12	> "We evaluate both generation modes because real-world recursive contamination can arise from either. Our analysis reveals generation mode as a significant confound, leading us to recommend continuation mode as the canonical condition for cross-model comparisons."
13	
14	| Condition | Pythia↔OLMo | Qwen↔others | 论文定位 |
15	|-----------|-------------|-------------|---------|
16	| Continuation | 90-92% retention | 80-85% retention | **主实验条件** — cross-model claims 的基础 |
17	| Rewrite (instruction) | N/A | 61-63% retention | **upper bound with mode-specific confound** — 仅作 ablation |
18	
19	**原则**：
20	- C1' 的跨模型 claim 必须基于 continuation mode 数据
21	- Rewrite mode 的高 AUC (0.6957 vs cont 0.6114) 是 mode-specific signal amplification，不能作为泛化性证据
22	- mvp-001 (Qwen-rewrite) 定位为 "pilot study demonstrating feasibility"，后续用 continuation mode rigorously validate
23	- cont→rw 89% vs rw→cont 82% 不对称性 → continuation features 是 rewrite 的通用子集
24	
25	## Core Claims (2+1 结构, updated D049/D050)
26	
27	### Primary: C1' (K* Characterization — Domain-Dependent Bounded Saturation)
28	首次系统测量递归合成文本的 generational discrimination boundary K*，demonstrating that K* is low-bounded and domain-dependent, with a two-tier ceiling structure: model-free features yield K*∈{1,2,3}, while neural classifiers extend to K*=4 on structured domains。
29	
30	DPI 理论证明有限 K*_theory 必然存在（信息论 impossibility boundary）；我们首次在受控实验中测量 K*_empirical，它提供 K*_theory 的保守下界。通过 10 model configurations（6 architecture families, 1B-14B）、4 source domains（C4, Wikipedia, arXiv, Code/Python）、4 decoding strategies 系统表征 K*_empirical 的行为，发现：
31	
32	- **K*_OBD ∈{1,2,3} at θ=0.60（model-free feature ceiling）**：在 15D model-free statistical features + LightGBM 下，K* 是有界的且域依赖的，呈现 domain ceiling 阶梯：Wikipedia ceiling=1, C4/Code ceiling=2, arXiv ceiling=3。Domain structure 设定 K* 上界（ceiling），model 的 domain-specific generation competence 决定是否达到 ceiling（D076）
33	- **DeBERTa K* 可超越 OBD ceiling（neural upper bound, D084）**：DeBERTa-v3-base fine-tuned classifier 在 arXiv 上 K*=4（3v4 AUC=0.6238, ci_lower=0.6127 > θ），首次观测到 K*>3。跨域对比：C4 gap=0（K*_OBD=K*_DeBERTa=2, representation-independent boundary），Wiki gap=+1~2（DeBERTa K*=3 vs OBD K*=1-2），arXiv gap=+1（DeBERTa K*=4 vs OBD K*=3）。C4 是唯一 representation-independent 的域——即便 neural classifier 也无法突破 K*=2，说明 C4 的信息丧失是 fundamental。DeBERTa 在结构化域（Wiki/arXiv）的 K* 增量来自 OBD 无法捕获的 structural depth signal（LaTeX/citation/math patterns）。论文定位：OBD K* 是 practical deployable lower bound，DeBERTa K* 是 neural upper bound，gap 量化 classifier power 对 K* 的边际贡献
34	- **Web text K*=2 是 dominant mode**（C4 7/9 continuation-mode configurations, 2 competence-limited at K*=1: Gemma-2-2B, Mistral-7B），Code domain ceiling=2（Qwen-1.5B K*=2, AUC 1v2=0.7382; Pythia-1.4B K*=1, AUC 1v2=0.5983——code generation competence 不足未达 ceiling，与 Mistral C4 K*=1 模式一致）。Code 与 C4 共享 ceiling=2 但 JSD cliff 位置不同（Code 在 1v2→2v3 collapse，C4 在 0v1→1v2），说明 domain structure 不仅决定 K* ceiling 还影响信号衰减模式。**Cross-family validation (D079, D080)**: LLaMA-3.1-8B K*=2 (1v2 AUC=0.7394, CI [0.729, 0.750], JSD cliff 13.5x, scored by Qwen) confirmed Code ceiling=2 不是 Qwen 家族特有。Pythia-1.4B scorer 重评 Qwen Code generations K*=2 confirmed (Δ=-1.9pp)。与 Wiki 域的 scorer confound（same-family scorer inflates K* 1→2）形成对比，说明 scorer confound 是域相关（domain-specific）而非系统性的。当前状态：Qwen-1.5B K*=2, LLaMA-8B K*=2, Pythia-1.4B K*=1; Mistral-7B/Qwen-7B pending
35	- **Structured academic text (arXiv) K*=3**，经五个模型配置、四个架构族 cross-validate（Qwen-1.5B, Qwen-7B, Pythia-1.4B, LLaMA-8B, Mistral-7B; 5/5 domain-competent models, 100%）
36	- **Wikipedia K*=1 (scorer-controlled)**：全部 6 个模型在 cross-family scorer 控制后均 K*=1。Qwen 生成器在 same-family scorer 下的 K*=2 是 scorer family bias artifact（D060 确认），正文报告 scorer-controlled 值，Appendix 披露 confound 细节
37	- **Mistral-7B K*=1 on C4 but K*=3 on arXiv**：domain-specific one-wash，最强 domain dependence 证据
38	- **Domain 是 K* 的主要决定因素（primary determinant with domain ceiling）**：domain structure 设定 K* ceiling，scorer control 后 model scale/architecture/decoding strategy 不改变域 ceiling。Model domain-specific competence 调制实际 K*，但从不超过 ceiling（可证伪预测）。此 model×domain interaction 在中间复杂度域（C4, Code）最显著，在极端域（Wiki K*=1 全票、arXiv K*=3 全票）消失
39	- **One-wash laundering effect**：对 web text 和 Wikipedia，单次生成即令文本与更深层合成内容不可区分
40	
41	**子组件：**
42	
43	**(a) K*=2 as dominant mode for web text (7/9 continuation-mode configurations)**
44	> **7/9 continuation-mode configurations yield K*=2 on C4 web text（2 competence-limited at K*=1: Gemma-2-2B, Mistral-7B）：**
45	>
46	> | Model | Experiment | AUC 1v2 | 95% CI | CI lower > 0.60? |
47	> |-------|-----------|---------|--------|-----------------|
48	> | Pythia-1.4B cont | exp-001 | 0.6539 | [0.6454, 0.6630] | ✅ (+4.5pp) |

# Paper Framing — gen-depth-contamination

## Target Venue
- Primary: EMNLP 2026 Main (ARR submission May 25, 2026)
- Fallback: EMNLP 2026 Findings
- Backup: AAAI 2027 (abstract July 25, paper August 1)

## Canonical Experimental Condition

**Continuation mode 是 cross-model 结论的基础。**

> "We evaluate both generation modes because real-world recursive contamination can arise from either. Our analysis reveals generation mode as a significant confound, leading us to recommend continuation mode as the canonical condition for cross-model comparisons."

| Condition | Pythia↔OLMo | Qwen↔others | 论文定位 |
|-----------|-------------|-------------|---------|
| Continuation | 90-92% retention | 80-85% retention | **主实验条件** — cross-model claims 的基础 |
| Rewrite (instruction) | N/A | 61-63% retention | **upper bound with mode-specific confound** — 仅作 ablation |

**原则**：
- C1' 的跨模型 claim 必须基于 continuation mode 数据
- Rewrite mode 的高 AUC (0.6957 vs cont 0.6114) 是 mode-specific signal amplification，不能作为泛化性证据
- mvp-001 (Qwen-rewrite) 定位为 "pilot study demonstrating feasibility"，后续用 continuation mode rigorously validate
- cont→rw 89% vs rw→cont 82% 不对称性 → continuation features 是 rewrite 的通用子集

## Core Claims (2+1 结构, updated D049/D050)

### Primary: C1' (K* Characterization — Domain-Dependent Bounded Saturation)
首次系统测量递归合成文本的 generational discrimination boundary K*，demonstrating that K* is low-bounded and domain-dependent, with a two-tier ceiling structure: model-free features yield K*∈{1,2,3}, while neural classifiers extend to K*=4 on structured domains。

DPI 理论证明有限 K*_theory 必然存在（信息论 impossibility boundary）；我们首次在受控实验中测量 K*_empirical，它提供 K*_theory 的保守下界。通过 10 model configurations（6 architecture families, 1B-14B）、4 source domains（C4, Wikipedia, arXiv, Code/Python）、4 decoding strategies 系统表征 K*_empirical 的行为，发现：

- **K*_OBD ∈{1,2,3} at θ=0.60（model-free feature ceiling）**：在 15D model-free statistical features + LightGBM 下，K* 是有界的且域依赖的，呈现 domain ceiling 阶梯：Wikipedia ceiling=1, C4/Code ceiling=2, arXiv ceiling=3。Domain structure 设定 K* 上界（ceiling），model 的 domain-specific generation competence 决定是否达到 ceiling（D076）
- **DeBERTa K* 可超越 OBD ceiling（neural upper bound, D084）**：DeBERTa-v3-base fine-tuned classifier 在 arXiv 上 K*=4（3v4 AUC=0.6238, ci_lower=0.6127 > θ），首次观测到 K*>3。跨域对比：C4 gap=0（K*_OBD=K*_DeBERTa=2, representation-independent boundary），Wiki gap=+1~2（DeBERTa K*=3 vs OBD K*=1-2），arXiv gap=+1（DeBERTa K*=4 vs OBD K*=3）。C4 是唯一 representation-independent 的域——即便 neural classifier 也无法突破 K*=2，说明 C4 的信息丧失是 fundamental。DeBERTa 在结构化域（Wiki/arXiv）的 K* 增量来自 OBD 无法捕获的 structural depth signal（LaTeX/citation/math patterns）。论文定位：OBD K* 是 practical deployable lower bound，DeBERTa K* 是 neural upper bound，gap 量化 classifier power 对 K* 的边际贡献
- **Web text K*=2 是 dominant mode**（C4 7/9 continuation-mode configurations, 2 competence-limited at K*=1: Gemma-2-2B, Mistral-7B），Code domain ceiling=2（Qwen-1.5B K*=2, AUC 1v2=0.7382; Pythia-1.4B K*=1, AUC 1v2=0.5983——code generation competence 不足未达 ceiling，与 Mistral C4 K*=1 模式一致）。Code 与 C4 共享 ceiling=2 但 JSD cliff 位置不同（Code 在 1v2→2v3 collapse，C4 在 0v1→1v2），说明 domain structure 不仅决定 K* ceiling 还影响信号衰减模式。**Cross-family validation (D079, D080)**: LLaMA-3.1-8B K*=2 (1v2 AUC=0.7394, CI [0.729, 0.750], JSD cliff 13.5x, scored by Qwen) confirmed Code ceiling=2 不是 Qwen 家族特有。Pythia-1.4B scorer 重评 Qwen Code generations K*=2 confirmed (Δ=-1.9pp)。与 Wiki 域的 scorer confound（same-family scorer inflates K* 1→2）形成对比，说明 scorer confound 是域相关（domain-specific）而非系统性的。当前状态：Qwen-1.5B K*=2, LLaMA-8B K*=2, Pythia-1.4B K*=1; Mistral-7B/Qwen-7B pending
- **Structured academic text (arXiv) K*=3**，经五个模型配置、四个架构族 cross-validate（Qwen-1.5B, Qwen-7B, Pythia-1.4B, LLaMA-8B, Mistral-7B; 5/5 domain-competent models, 100%）
- **Wikipedia K*=1 (scorer-controlled)**：全部 6 个模型在 cross-family scorer 控制后均 K*=1。Qwen 生成器在 same-family scorer 下的 K*=2 是 scorer family bias artifact（D060 确认），正文报告 scorer-controlled 值，Appendix 披露 confound 细节
- **Mistral-7B K*=1 on C4 but K*=3 on arXiv**：domain-specific one-wash，最强 domain dependence 证据
- **Domain 是 K* 的主要决定因素（primary determinant with domain ceiling）**：domain structure 设定 K* ceiling，scorer control 后 model scale/architecture/decoding strategy 不改变域 ceiling。Model domain-specific competence 调制实际 K*，但从不超过 ceiling（可证伪预测）。此 model×domain interaction 在中间复杂度域（C4, Code）最显著，在极端域（Wiki K*=1 全票、arXiv K*=3 全票）消失
- **One-wash laundering effect**：对 web text 和 Wikipedia，单次生成即令文本与更深层合成内容不可区分

**子组件：**

**(a) K*=2 as dominant mode for web text (7/9 continuation-mode configurations)**
> **7/9 continuation-mode configurations yield K*=2 on C4 web text（2 competence-limited at K*=1: Gemma-2-2B, Mistral-7B）：**
